title: Windows app v2.6.1: clearer Prev Server and tray history control
items: Prev Server now shows what it will rejoin: the button carries the game name and a tooltip shows the game plus server ID, and the status line confirms the target.
The tray menu gained a Clear history action to wipe the recent-join list.

title: Pinned games in the Windows app (v2.6.0)
items: Windows app v2.6.0: pin your favorite games for one-click joining without a link - paste a game link and click Pin current.
Pinned games appear as buttons in the app window and under Pinned games in the tray menu; right-click a pin to remove it.
Pins are saved next to the exe (pinned.txt) and remember the real game name.

title: Arctic Joiner v2.5.0: sniper repair and mirror reliability
items: Fixed the /snipe page: its inline script contained stray escape sequences that stopped the whole User Sniper from running, so the snipe, Keep watching, and join features now work again.
Windows app v2.5.0: the self-updater now points at the current repository and the in-app version matches version.txt, so update checks no longer loop.
Repointed all site links, download URLs, and the community issue link to the current repository host.
API mirror fallback now checks the HTTP status, so a rate-limited mirror correctly falls through to the backup instead of showing an error payload.
Invite pages now display the real game name (fixed an incorrect casing on the games API field).

title: Server browser, game info, and app quality upgrades
items: Added /servers: paste a game link to see every public server with player counts and one-tap join; auto-refreshes every 30 seconds.
Invite pages now show the real game name instead of just the place ID.
The user sniper gained a Keep watching mode that rescans every 30 seconds until the target is found.
Windows app v2.1.0: single instance with link forwarding, plus a toast notification showing the launched game's name.
Server browser: per-server Copy Invite Link button that shares an exact-server join link, and recent games quick-select.

title: User Sniper page
items: Added /snipe: type a username or user ID (optionally with a game link to scan that game directly) and it finds their exact public server, with a one-tap join and target avatar confirmation.
Removed the user sniper from the Windows app to keep it a lean instant-joiner.

title: games/start links and Windows instant-join app
items: Windows app now auto-fetches updates from GitHub: it checks for new versions on launch and installs them with one click (downloads, rebuilds, and swaps itself).
Added one-line install script for the Windows app that fetches and builds the latest version from GitHub.
Redesigned the menu around a single paste box: paste any link and the best join option is chosen automatically, with an Advanced panel for manual entry.
Fixed paste detection: normal game URLs (place ID in the path) and links pasted without https:// now work.
Added support for Roblox games/start links with placeId and launchData (https://www.roblox.com/games/start?placeId=...&launchData=...).
Pasting a games/start link in the menu now fills the place ID and launch data automatically.
Invite pages now build roblox:// deep links with launch data for instant joins.
Added a Windows desktop app (windows-app) that pastes a link and instantly launches Froststrap with it, no browser needed.

title: Community system and Discord verification
items: Added Discord verification for community private server submissions.
Added review-based community submission flow for private server share links.
Added global changelogs route support.

title: Private servers page improvements
items: Added dedicated /ps page for curated private servers.
Added search, category filtering, and sorting.
Improved menu layout and route handling for GitHub Pages.
